enemies.name: Slag-Rat Courier
enemies.notes: Darts along the laundry wires and steals 1 BP per hit. High Conductivity reveals its route. Drops batteries (Static leaves them for the white-ear children).

enemies.name: RAM Fixer Twins
enemies.notes: One entry is one twin: encounters list the key twice. Two units tethered by oden steam (shield 6 each). Unless both Break inside the same Sync window, the survivor rewinds 1 plate onto the broken one (the heal should target only the broken twin and only outside a shared Sync window). Drops Conductivity Gel.

enemies.name: Pachinko ICE
enemies.notes: Mini-boss. Spawns when Neon Bloom stealth fails: an Arch-Curator reskin with a rotating thoracic Gatling ring, clay thumbprint normals inside cel lines. The ring's 4-step ramp swaps a third weakness between [RUIN] and [FERRO] every 6 s (rotating carrier weakness, needs a timer that edits the weakness list). Static's CARRION reveals the Lavos-fibre core. Break: masks weep black oil, crack-slide like Crono at 20%.

enemies.name: White-Ear Child Echo
enemies.notes: Ghosts of the children plugged in before Static. Untargetable unless Static is tuned to SIGNAL; visible only while the party is BLIND. Grief-Resonance (-2 MP per 10 s, far-plane blur). Spared: Static leaves batteries on their CRTs.

enemies.name: Oil-Fire Bike Bro
enemies.notes: Neo-Tokyo slide dash plus an oil-fire DoT circle (radius 3.0). Leaves an Ash Field Krona can feed on. Drops the Red Bike chain.

enemies.name: Hiss Larva Drone
enemies.notes: Shield 3, +1 plate per second while within 6 m of a TV (a conditional regeneration tied to TV props, not the standard regenerating rule). White Noise AoE: Confuse. Tracking Hold: Time Stop on one battler for 3 s. Its magic circles on the floor are erased only by Static's NOISE.
